what:
fuzz target syntax_reparse (and syntax_parse once its stack overflow is fixed) fails in syntax::validation::validate_block_structure (validation.rs:253, called by syntax::fuzz::check_file_invariants from CheckReparse::run and check_parser): the assertion that each } pairs with the { before it as a sibling is false for the parser on real input, both for full parses and reparses. Two causes seen in cargo-test3.log: (1) text whose braces are unbalanced in the source, e.g. `fn main(){ use foo::{a a Other); }` (the use-tree-list { never closes, so the block } pairs with it); no parser can satisfy a stack pairing there. (2) a `}` wrapped in ERROR by stmt()s err_and_bump after attributes (parser grammar/expressions.rs:91, upstream test attr_end_of_stmt_list.rast already shows ERROR(R_CURLY)); v2 made doc comments parsed DOC_COMMENT elements, so `fn main(){ /// doc
}` now eats the block } too, putting every later item inside the fn (a recovery regression vs rust-analyzer, where /// is trivia). Asks: fix (2) in the parser (e.g. after outer attrs, at } report the error without bumping, leaving it to stmt_list; MACRO_STMTS still needs a bump on a bare }), update attr_end_of_stmt_list.rast; and decide the invariant for (1): check block structure only on texts whose braces balance as tokens, or compare against the full parse only (CheckReparse already compares every node kind and range with the full parse, which implies the same structure). tests-fuzz has not edited crates/syntax or crates/parser.
